decisions.reason: Because the firm has invested since 2018, publicly featured it on its own page, and its central airfield role makes weak results seem temporary, management persists.
Its surveillance function is central and publicly committed, so escalation pressures outweigh disappointing signals.
Although training is peripheral to the integrated-software direction, the dedicated page signals sufficient public commitment to keep it for now.
As a peripheral training course with only a mention and no dedicated page, the firm has the weakest sunk-cost and public-commitment pressures, so it is most likely to be dropped.
The collaboration tool is highly central to the announced shift toward integrated, collaborative operations and was publicly featured, so strong escalation makes dropping unlikely.
The multilateration surveillance system supports the firm's automation and capacity goals and had its own page, so commitment is high and management keeps it.
